016package org.vafer.jdeb.producers;
017
018import java.io.File;
019import java.io.IOException;
020import org.apache.tools.ant.DirectoryScanner;
021import org.vafer.jdeb.DataConsumer;
022import org.vafer.jdeb.DataProducer;
023import org.vafer.jdeb.mapping.Mapper;
024import org.vafer.jdeb.utils.Utils;
025
026/**
027 * DataProducer iterating over a directory.
028 * For cross-platform permissions and ownerships you probably want to use a Mapper, too.
029 */
030public final class DataProducerDirectory
031  extends AbstractDataProducer
032  implements DataProducer
033{
034
035  private final DirectoryScanner scanner = new DirectoryScanner();
036
037  public DataProducerDirectory(
038    final File pDir,
039    final String[] pIncludes,
040    final String[] pExcludes,
041    final Mapper[] pMappers
042  ) {
043    super(pIncludes, pExcludes, pMappers);
044    scanner.setBasedir(pDir);
045    scanner.setIncludes(pIncludes);
046    scanner.setExcludes(pExcludes);
047    scanner.setCaseSensitive(true);
048    scanner.setFollowSymlinks(true);
049  }
050
051  public void produce(final DataConsumer pReceiver) throws IOException {
052    scanner.scan();
053
054    final File baseDir = scanner.getBasedir();
055
056    for (String dir : scanner.getIncludedDirectories()) {
057      final File file = new File(baseDir, dir);
058      String dirname = getFilename(baseDir, file);
059
060      if ("".equals(dirname)) {
061        continue;
062      }
063
064      if ('/' != File.separatorChar) {
065        dirname = dirname.replace(File.separatorChar, '/');
066      }
067
068      if (!isIncluded(dirname)) {
069        continue;
070      }
071
072      if (!dirname.endsWith("/")) {
073        dirname += "/";
074      }
075
076      produceDir(pReceiver, dirname);
077    }
078
079    for (String f : scanner.getIncludedFiles()) {
080      final File file = new File(baseDir, f);
081      String filename = getFilename(baseDir, file);
082
083      if ('/' != File.separatorChar) {
084        filename = filename.replace(File.separatorChar, '/');
085      }
086
087      if (!isIncluded(filename)) {
088        continue;
089      }
090
091      produceFile(pReceiver, file, filename);
092    }
093  }
094
095  private String getFilename(File root, File file) {
096    final String relativeFilename = file
097      .getAbsolutePath()
098      .substring(root.getAbsolutePath().length());
099
100    return Utils.stripLeadingSlash(relativeFilename);
101  }
102}
